title: Percentages & Applications
description: Fraction conversions, population growth, profit percentage & successive changes.
formulaPreview:
• Percentage = (Value / Total) × 100%
• Percentage Increase = [(New - Original) / Original] × 100%
• Fraction Equivalents: 1/2 = 50%, 1/3 = 33.33%, 1/4 = 25%, 1/5 = 20%

title: Ratios & Proportions
description: Direct and inverse proportions, mixture problems, partnership share calculations.
formulaPreview:
• Ratio a:b = a/b
• Proportion: If a:b = c:d, then a × d = b × c
• Compounded Ratio of (a:b) and (c:d) = (ac : bd)

title: Averages & Weighted Means
description: Arithmetic mean, weighted average formulas, speed averages across distance segments.
formulaPreview:
• Average = (Sum of All Observations) / (Total Number of Observations)
• Average Speed = (Total Distance) / (Total Time Taken)
• Weighted Average = (w1x1 + w2x2) / (w1 + w2)

title: Profit and Loss
description: Cost price, selling price, marked price, trade discount and margin percentage calculations.
formulaPreview:
• Profit = SP - CP | Loss = CP - SP
• Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100%
• SP = [(100 + Profit%) / 100] × CP

title: Time and Work
description: Individual work efficiency, pipe and cistern rates, man-hours efficiency equivalence.
formulaPreview:
• If A completes a work in 'n' days, A's 1 day work = 1/n
• Work Done = Rate × Time
• (M1 × D1 × H1) / W1 = (M2 × D2 × H2) / W2

title: Number Series & Pattern Analysis
description: Missing term identification, Fibonacci sequences, alternate difference and prime patterns.
formulaPreview:
• Common Types: Arithmetic (+d), Geometric (×r), Square/Cube differences (n² ± k).
• Tip: Calculate differences between consecutive terms twice to detect sub-patterns.

title: Direction Sense Test
description: Compass direction navigation, pythagorean displacement, shadow orientation relative to sun.
formulaPreview:
• Shortest Distance = √(x² + y²) [Pythagoras Theorem]
• Sunrise: Shadow falls towards West.
• Sunset: Shadow falls towards East.

title: Syllogisms & Deductive Logic
description: Venn diagram deductive logic, universal positive/negative statements, conditional inferences.
formulaPreview:
• All A are B (Inclusion)
• No A is B (Exclusive)
• Some A are B (Intersection)
• Rule: A conclusion is valid ONLY if it follows logically in ALL possible Venn configurations.

title: Grammar & Vocabulary
description: Subject-verb agreement, common idioms, sentence corrections, synonyms and antonyms.
formulaPreview:
• Subject-Verb Agreement: Singular subject requires singular verb.
• Active vs Passive Voice: Focus on agent vs patient of action.
• Contextual Clues: Pay attention to contrast words like 'however', 'despite', 'nonetheless'.

title: Reading Comprehension & Analysis
description: Paragraph tone analysis, central thesis identification, logical inferences & weaken arguments.
formulaPreview:
• Main Idea: Identify topic sentence in intro/conclusion.
• Tone Analysis: Pay attention to adjectives (e.g. alarmist, neutral, optimistic).
• Inferences: Must follow strictly from passage evidence.
